title: Staircase — one Math Engine, waist slabs on beams, handrails and balusters
description:
A parametric STAIRCASE on the six-node spine:

  Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render

DROP IT ON A NODE. Three configurations — Straight, U-shape (dog-leg with a landing at the far end), U-shape (mid landing) — set out from the host point along `direction`: first tread at the anchor, landing at the far end. The plan footprint is unchanged from the earlier version, so every plan that already places this object keeps placing it exactly.

THE 3D IS A CAST STAIR, NOT A STAIRCASE-SHAPED BLOCK. Each flight is a WAIST SLAB with the steps on it: one polyhedron from the flight's side profile — the sawtooth of risers and treads, a drop at the landing end, and the soffit back down along the pitch line offset by the waist thickness measured perpendicular to the slope — extruded across the flight width. Each landing is a slab of its own thickness on a BEAM along its outer edge, not a block down to the floor. A HANDRAIL runs above the nosing line on the side you choose (Inner = the well side of a dog-leg, the left of a straight flight) with square BALUSTERS on every tread at the spacing you set. Open-riser stairs keep tread-only boxes, because an open stair has no waist.

WHAT IT REPORTS. Riser, tread, total rise, going, pitch, the 2R + T comfort rule; concrete volume as flights + landings + beams; formwork area (soffits, risers, and both sides of every flight — what the shuttering is priced on); concrete weight at 25 kN/m³; handrail length along the slope; baluster count; flight count and waist. At the defaults (14 risers, 280 tread, 1.0 m wide, 150 waist): 1.7 m³ of concrete, 42 kN.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO. The soffit is one plane per flight; there is no kite winder, no nosing overhang, no top or bottom newel post, and the mid-landing configuration has rails on its flights but not across its landings. It does not cut the slab it lands on.

params.name: Staircase maths
params.expr:
_n = rows(P)
_cx = _n >= 1 ? mean(col(P, 0)) : 0
_cy = _n >= 1 ? mean(col(P, 1)) : 0
_a = rotation * PI / 180
_ca = cos(_a)
_sa = sin(_a)
_S = vcat(hcat(-1, -1), hcat(1, -1), hcat(1, 1), hcat(-1, 1))
_ux = (col(_S, 0) + 1) / 2
_uy = (col(_S, 1) + 1) / 2
_N = max(2, min(60, round(steps)))
_T = max(0.05, tread)
_W = max(0.1, width)
_L = max(0, landingWidth)
_G = max(0, midSpace)
_R = max(0.05, riser)
_MS = round(midSteps)
_dir = direction == 'Right to left' ? -1 : 1
_open = stepStyle == 'Open' ? 1 : 0
_TT = max(0.01, treadThickness)
_isU = config == 'U-shape'
_isUM = config == 'U-shape (mid landing)'
_n1 = (_MS > 0 && _MS < _N) ? _MS : floor(_N / 2)
_n2 = _N - _n1
_mid = (_MS > 0 && _MS < _N - 1) ? _MS : max(1, round(_N / 3))
_rem = max(2, _N - _mid)
_pa = ceil(_rem / 2)
_pb = _rem - _pa
_xt = _isUM ? _dir * _pa * _T : _dir * _n1 * _T
_xl = _xt + _dir * _L
_xr = _xt + _dir * _W
_y2 = _W + _mid * _T
_y3 = _y2 + _W
Steps = zeros(0, 3)
StepMesh = zeros(0, 4)
Landings = zeros(0, 3)
LandMesh = zeros(0, 4)
_f1 = _isUM ? _pa : (_isU ? _n1 : _N)
loop i in _f1:
  _bx0 = _dir * i * _T
  _bx1 = _dir * (i + 1) * _T
  _by0 = 0
  _by1 = _W
  _h1 = (i + 1) * _R
  _h0 = _open > 0 ? max(0, _h1 - _TT) : 0
  _px = _bx0 + _ux * (_bx1 - _bx0)
  _py = _by0 + _uy * (_by1 - _by0)
  _ring = hcat(_cx + _px * _ca - _py * _sa, _cy + _px * _sa + _py * _ca)
  Steps = vcat(Steps, hcat(_ring, fill(4, 1, i)))
  StepMesh = vcat(StepMesh, mprism(_ring, _h0, _h1))
end
_f2 = _isUM ? _mid : (_isU ? _n2 : 0)
loop k in _f2:
  _bx0 = _isUM ? _xt : (_xt - _dir * k * _T)
  _bx1 = _isUM ? _xr : (_xt - _dir * (k + 1) * _T)
  _by0 = _isUM ? (_W + k * _T) : (_W + _G)
  _by1 = _isUM ? (_W + (k + 1) * _T) : (2 * _W + _G)
  _h1 = _isUM ? (_pa + k + 1) * _R : (_n1 + k + 1) * _R
  _h0 = _open > 0 ? max(0, _h1 - _TT) : 0
  _px = _bx0 + _ux * (_bx1 - _bx0)
  _py = _by0 + _uy * (_by1 - _by0)
  _ring = hcat(_cx + _px * _ca - _py * _sa, _cy + _px * _sa + _py * _ca)
  Steps = vcat(Steps, hcat(_ring, fill(4, 1, 100 + k)))
  StepMesh = vcat(StepMesh, mprism(_ring, _h0, _h1))
end
_f3 = _isUM ? _pb : 0
loop j in _f3:
  _bx0 = _xt - _dir * j * _T
  _bx1 = _xt - _dir * (j + 1) * _T
  _by0 = _y2
  _by1 = _y3
  _h1 = (_pa + _mid + j + 1) * _R
  _h0 = _open > 0 ? max(0, _h1 - _TT) : 0
  _px = _bx0 + _ux * (_bx1 - _bx0)
  _py = _by0 + _uy * (_by1 - _by0)
  _ring = hcat(_cx + _px * _ca - _py * _sa, _cy + _px * _sa + _py * _ca)
  Steps = vcat(Steps, hcat(_ring, fill(4, 1, 200 + j)))
  StepMesh = vcat(StepMesh, mprism(_ring, _h0, _h1))
end
_LT = max(0.05, landingThickness)
_wv = max(0.05, waist) * sqrt(_T * _T + _R * _R) / _T
_RH = max(0.3, railHeight)
_rs = max(0.005, railSize) / 2
_ri = max(0, railInset)
_bpt = max(1, round(_T / max(0.03, balusterSpacing)))
_bh = max(0.005, balusterSize) / 2
_BSQ0 = vcat(vcat(hcat(0 - _bh), hcat(_bh)), vcat(hcat(_bh), hcat(0 - _bh)))
_BSQ1 = vcat(vcat(hcat(0 - _bh), hcat(0 - _bh)), vcat(hcat(_bh), hcat(_bh)))
_both = railSide == 'Both'
_none = railSide == 'None'
_left = railSide == 'Left' || (railSide == 'Inner' && !(_isU || _isUM))
_right = railSide == 'Right'
_inner = railSide == 'Inner' && (_isU || _isUM)
_rlA = (_both || _left) ? 1 : 0
_rrA = (_both || _right || _inner) ? 1 : 0
_rlB = (_both || _left || _inner) ? 1 : 0
_rrB = (_both || _right) ? 1 : 0
Flights3D = zeros(0, 4)
Rail3D = zeros(0, 4)
Bal3D = zeros(0, 4)
RailPlan = zeros(0, 4)
balusterCount = 0
handrailLength = 0
flightConcrete = 0
formworkArea = 0

# ── flight A: _f1 steps from (0, 0) along (_dir, 0), across (0, 1), base 0
_nA = _f1
_oxA = 0
_oyA = 0
_dxA = _dir
_dyA = 0
_axA = 0
_ayA = 1
_z0A = 0
_rlA = _rlA
_rrA = _rrA
_PFA = hcat(0, 0)
loop i in _nA:
  _PFA = vcat(_PFA, vcat(hcat(i * _T, (i + 1) * _R), hcat((i + 1) * _T, (i + 1) * _R)))
end
_PFA = vcat(_PFA, vcat(hcat(_nA * _T, _nA * _R - _wv), hcat(_wv * _T / _R, 0)))
_mA = rows(_PFA)
_psA = col(_PFA, 0)
_pzA = col(_PFA, 1) + _z0A
_p0xA = _oxA + _dxA * _psA
_p0yA = _oyA + _dyA * _psA
_p1xA = _p0xA + _axA * _W
_p1yA = _p0yA + _ayA * _W
_S0A = hcat(_cx + _p0xA * _ca - _p0yA * _sa, _cy + _p0xA * _sa + _p0yA * _ca, _pzA, fill(_mA, 1, 0))
_S1A = hcat(_cx + _p1xA * _ca - _p1yA * _sa, _cy + _p1xA * _sa + _p1yA * _ca, _pzA, fill(_mA, 1, 0 + 1))
_QA = zeros(0, 4)
loop k in (_mA - 1):
  _sa0 = sub(_psA, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _sa1 = sub(_psA, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _za0 = sub(_pzA, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _za1 = sub(_pzA, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _qa = hcat(_oxA + _dxA * _sa0, _oyA + _dyA * _sa0)
  _qb = hcat(_oxA + _dxA * _sa1, _oyA + _dyA * _sa1)
  _qc = _qb + hcat(_axA * _W, _ayA * _W)
  _qd = _qa + hcat(_axA * _W, _ayA * _W)
  _q4 = vcat(vcat(_qa, _qb), vcat(_qc, _qd))
  _qz = vcat(vcat(hcat(_za0), hcat(_za1)), vcat(hcat(_za1), hcat(_za0)))
  _qw = hcat(_cx + col(_q4, 0) * _ca - col(_q4, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_q4, 0) * _sa + col(_q4, 1) * _ca, _qz, fill(4, 1, 0 + 2 + k))
  _QA = vcat(_QA, _qw)
end
Flights3D = (_open > 0 || _nA == 0) ? Flights3D : vcat(Flights3D, vcat(vcat(_S0A, _S1A), _QA))
# balusters: _bpt per tread, at the rail inset on each railed side, from tread top to rail height
loop b in (_nA * _bpt):
  _bi = floor(b / _bpt)
  _bs = _bi * _T + (b - _bi * _bpt + 0.5) * _T / _bpt
  _bz0 = _z0A + (_bi + 1) * _R
  _bz1 = _bz0 + _RH
  _bl = hcat(_oxA + _dxA * _bs + _axA * _ri, _oyA + _dyA * _bs + _ayA * _ri)
  _br = hcat(_oxA + _dxA * _bs + _axA * (_W - _ri), _oyA + _dyA * _bs + _ayA * (_W - _ri))
  _blr = hcat(_cx + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  _brr = hcat(_cx + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  Bal3D = _rlA > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_blr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
  Bal3D = _rrA > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_brr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
end
balusterCount = balusterCount + _nA * _bpt * (_rlA + _rrA)
# handrail: a sloped bar from above the first nosing to above the last, on each railed side
_h0zA = _z0A + _R + _RH
_h1zA = _z0A + _nA * _R + _RH
loop s in 2:
  _wside = s == 0 ? _ri : (_W - _ri)
  _on = _nA > 0 ? (s == 0 ? _rlA : _rrA) : 0
  _c0 = hcat(_oxA + _axA * _wside, _oyA + _ayA * _wside)
  _c1 = hcat(_oxA + _dxA * _nA * _T + _axA * _wside, _oyA + _dyA * _nA * _T + _ayA * _wside)
  _cw = hcat(_axA * _rs, _ayA * _rs)
  _r8 = vcat(vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)), vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)))
  _r8z = vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zA - _rs), hcat(_h0zA - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h1zA - _rs), hcat(_h1zA - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zA + _rs), hcat(_h0zA + _rs)), vcat(hcat(_h1zA + _rs), hcat(_h1zA + _rs)))))
  _r8w = hcat(_cx + col(_r8, 0) * _ca - col(_r8, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_r8, 0) * _sa + col(_r8, 1) * _ca, _r8z)
  _fb = 0 + 500 + s * 6
  _F0 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3))), fill(4, 1, _fb))
  _F1 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 5)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 1))
  _F2 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 5), row(_r8w, 4))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 2))
  _F3 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 1), row(_r8w, 2)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 5))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 3))
  _F4 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3)), vcat(row(_r8w, 7), row(_r8w, 6))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 4))
  _F5 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 3), row(_r8w, 0)), vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 5))
  Rail3D = _on > 0 ? vcat(Rail3D, vcat(vcat(vcat(_F0, _F1), vcat(_F2, _F3)), vcat(_F4, _F5))) : Rail3D
  RailPlan = _on > 0 ? vcat(RailPlan, hcat(_cx + col(_c0, 0) * _ca - col(_c0, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c0, 0) * _sa + col(_c0, 1) * _ca, _cx + col(_c1, 0) * _ca - col(_c1, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c1, 0) * _sa + col(_c1, 1) * _ca)) : RailPlan
  handrailLength = handrailLength + _on * _nA * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T))
end
_faA = _nA > 0 ? (_nA * _T * _R / 2 + _nA * _T * _wv - _wv * _wv * _T / (2 * _R)) : 0
flightConcrete = flightConcrete + (_open > 0 ? 0 : _faA * _W)
formworkArea = formworkArea + (_open > 0 ? 0 : (2 * _faA + _W * _nA * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T)) + _W * _nA * _R))


# ── flight B: (_isUM ? _mid : (_isU ? _n2 : 0)) steps from (_xt, (_isUM ? _W : (_W + _G))) along ((_isUM ? 0 : (0 - _dir)), (_isUM ? 1 : 0)), across ((_isUM ? _dir : 0), (_isUM ? 0 : 1)), base (_isUM ? _pa * _R : _n1 * _R)
_nB = (_isUM ? _mid : (_isU ? _n2 : 0))
_oxB = _xt
_oyB = (_isUM ? _W : (_W + _G))
_dxB = (_isUM ? 0 : (0 - _dir))
_dyB = (_isUM ? 1 : 0)
_axB = (_isUM ? _dir : 0)
_ayB = (_isUM ? 0 : 1)
_z0B = (_isUM ? _pa * _R : _n1 * _R)
_rlB = (_isUM ? _rrA : _rlB)
_rrB = (_isUM ? _rlA : _rrB)
_PFB = hcat(0, 0)
loop i in _nB:
  _PFB = vcat(_PFB, vcat(hcat(i * _T, (i + 1) * _R), hcat((i + 1) * _T, (i + 1) * _R)))
end
_PFB = vcat(_PFB, vcat(hcat(_nB * _T, _nB * _R - _wv), hcat(_wv * _T / _R, 0)))
_mB = rows(_PFB)
_psB = col(_PFB, 0)
_pzB = col(_PFB, 1) + _z0B
_p0xB = _oxB + _dxB * _psB
_p0yB = _oyB + _dyB * _psB
_p1xB = _p0xB + _axB * _W
_p1yB = _p0yB + _ayB * _W
_S0B = hcat(_cx + _p0xB * _ca - _p0yB * _sa, _cy + _p0xB * _sa + _p0yB * _ca, _pzB, fill(_mB, 1, 1000))
_S1B = hcat(_cx + _p1xB * _ca - _p1yB * _sa, _cy + _p1xB * _sa + _p1yB * _ca, _pzB, fill(_mB, 1, 1000 + 1))
_QB = zeros(0, 4)
loop k in (_mB - 1):
  _sa0 = sub(_psB, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _sa1 = sub(_psB, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _za0 = sub(_pzB, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _za1 = sub(_pzB, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _qa = hcat(_oxB + _dxB * _sa0, _oyB + _dyB * _sa0)
  _qb = hcat(_oxB + _dxB * _sa1, _oyB + _dyB * _sa1)
  _qc = _qb + hcat(_axB * _W, _ayB * _W)
  _qd = _qa + hcat(_axB * _W, _ayB * _W)
  _q4 = vcat(vcat(_qa, _qb), vcat(_qc, _qd))
  _qz = vcat(vcat(hcat(_za0), hcat(_za1)), vcat(hcat(_za1), hcat(_za0)))
  _qw = hcat(_cx + col(_q4, 0) * _ca - col(_q4, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_q4, 0) * _sa + col(_q4, 1) * _ca, _qz, fill(4, 1, 1000 + 2 + k))
  _QB = vcat(_QB, _qw)
end
Flights3D = (_open > 0 || _nB == 0) ? Flights3D : vcat(Flights3D, vcat(vcat(_S0B, _S1B), _QB))
# balusters: _bpt per tread, at the rail inset on each railed side, from tread top to rail height
loop b in (_nB * _bpt):
  _bi = floor(b / _bpt)
  _bs = _bi * _T + (b - _bi * _bpt + 0.5) * _T / _bpt
  _bz0 = _z0B + (_bi + 1) * _R
  _bz1 = _bz0 + _RH
  _bl = hcat(_oxB + _dxB * _bs + _axB * _ri, _oyB + _dyB * _bs + _ayB * _ri)
  _br = hcat(_oxB + _dxB * _bs + _axB * (_W - _ri), _oyB + _dyB * _bs + _ayB * (_W - _ri))
  _blr = hcat(_cx + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  _brr = hcat(_cx + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  Bal3D = _rlB > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_blr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
  Bal3D = _rrB > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_brr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
end
balusterCount = balusterCount + _nB * _bpt * (_rlB + _rrB)
# handrail: a sloped bar from above the first nosing to above the last, on each railed side
_h0zB = _z0B + _R + _RH
_h1zB = _z0B + _nB * _R + _RH
loop s in 2:
  _wside = s == 0 ? _ri : (_W - _ri)
  _on = _nB > 0 ? (s == 0 ? _rlB : _rrB) : 0
  _c0 = hcat(_oxB + _axB * _wside, _oyB + _ayB * _wside)
  _c1 = hcat(_oxB + _dxB * _nB * _T + _axB * _wside, _oyB + _dyB * _nB * _T + _ayB * _wside)
  _cw = hcat(_axB * _rs, _ayB * _rs)
  _r8 = vcat(vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)), vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)))
  _r8z = vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zB - _rs), hcat(_h0zB - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h1zB - _rs), hcat(_h1zB - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zB + _rs), hcat(_h0zB + _rs)), vcat(hcat(_h1zB + _rs), hcat(_h1zB + _rs)))))
  _r8w = hcat(_cx + col(_r8, 0) * _ca - col(_r8, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_r8, 0) * _sa + col(_r8, 1) * _ca, _r8z)
  _fb = 1000 + 500 + s * 6
  _F0 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3))), fill(4, 1, _fb))
  _F1 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 5)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 1))
  _F2 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 5), row(_r8w, 4))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 2))
  _F3 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 1), row(_r8w, 2)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 5))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 3))
  _F4 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3)), vcat(row(_r8w, 7), row(_r8w, 6))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 4))
  _F5 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 3), row(_r8w, 0)), vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 5))
  Rail3D = _on > 0 ? vcat(Rail3D, vcat(vcat(vcat(_F0, _F1), vcat(_F2, _F3)), vcat(_F4, _F5))) : Rail3D
  RailPlan = _on > 0 ? vcat(RailPlan, hcat(_cx + col(_c0, 0) * _ca - col(_c0, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c0, 0) * _sa + col(_c0, 1) * _ca, _cx + col(_c1, 0) * _ca - col(_c1, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c1, 0) * _sa + col(_c1, 1) * _ca)) : RailPlan
  handrailLength = handrailLength + _on * _nB * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T))
end
_faB = _nB > 0 ? (_nB * _T * _R / 2 + _nB * _T * _wv - _wv * _wv * _T / (2 * _R)) : 0
flightConcrete = flightConcrete + (_open > 0 ? 0 : _faB * _W)
formworkArea = formworkArea + (_open > 0 ? 0 : (2 * _faB + _W * _nB * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T)) + _W * _nB * _R))


# ── flight C: (_isUM ? _pb : 0) steps from (_xt, _y2) along ((0 - _dir), 0), across (0, 1), base ((_pa + _mid) * _R)
_nC = (_isUM ? _pb : 0)
_oxC = _xt
_oyC = _y2
_dxC = (0 - _dir)
_dyC = 0
_axC = 0
_ayC = 1
_z0C = ((_pa + _mid) * _R)
_rlC = _rlB
_rrC = _rrB
_PFC = hcat(0, 0)
loop i in _nC:
  _PFC = vcat(_PFC, vcat(hcat(i * _T, (i + 1) * _R), hcat((i + 1) * _T, (i + 1) * _R)))
end
_PFC = vcat(_PFC, vcat(hcat(_nC * _T, _nC * _R - _wv), hcat(_wv * _T / _R, 0)))
_mC = rows(_PFC)
_psC = col(_PFC, 0)
_pzC = col(_PFC, 1) + _z0C
_p0xC = _oxC + _dxC * _psC
_p0yC = _oyC + _dyC * _psC
_p1xC = _p0xC + _axC * _W
_p1yC = _p0yC + _ayC * _W
_S0C = hcat(_cx + _p0xC * _ca - _p0yC * _sa, _cy + _p0xC * _sa + _p0yC * _ca, _pzC, fill(_mC, 1, 2000))
_S1C = hcat(_cx + _p1xC * _ca - _p1yC * _sa, _cy + _p1xC * _sa + _p1yC * _ca, _pzC, fill(_mC, 1, 2000 + 1))
_QC = zeros(0, 4)
loop k in (_mC - 1):
  _sa0 = sub(_psC, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _sa1 = sub(_psC, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _za0 = sub(_pzC, k, 0, 1, 1)
  _za1 = sub(_pzC, k + 1, 0, 1, 1)
  _qa = hcat(_oxC + _dxC * _sa0, _oyC + _dyC * _sa0)
  _qb = hcat(_oxC + _dxC * _sa1, _oyC + _dyC * _sa1)
  _qc = _qb + hcat(_axC * _W, _ayC * _W)
  _qd = _qa + hcat(_axC * _W, _ayC * _W)
  _q4 = vcat(vcat(_qa, _qb), vcat(_qc, _qd))
  _qz = vcat(vcat(hcat(_za0), hcat(_za1)), vcat(hcat(_za1), hcat(_za0)))
  _qw = hcat(_cx + col(_q4, 0) * _ca - col(_q4, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_q4, 0) * _sa + col(_q4, 1) * _ca, _qz, fill(4, 1, 2000 + 2 + k))
  _QC = vcat(_QC, _qw)
end
Flights3D = (_open > 0 || _nC == 0) ? Flights3D : vcat(Flights3D, vcat(vcat(_S0C, _S1C), _QC))
# balusters: _bpt per tread, at the rail inset on each railed side, from tread top to rail height
loop b in (_nC * _bpt):
  _bi = floor(b / _bpt)
  _bs = _bi * _T + (b - _bi * _bpt + 0.5) * _T / _bpt
  _bz0 = _z0C + (_bi + 1) * _R
  _bz1 = _bz0 + _RH
  _bl = hcat(_oxC + _dxC * _bs + _axC * _ri, _oyC + _dyC * _bs + _ayC * _ri)
  _br = hcat(_oxC + _dxC * _bs + _axC * (_W - _ri), _oyC + _dyC * _bs + _ayC * (_W - _ri))
  _blr = hcat(_cx + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_bl, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_bl, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  _brr = hcat(_cx + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _ca - (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _sa, _cy + (col(_br, 0) + _BSQ0) * _sa + (col(_br, 1) + _BSQ1) * _ca)
  Bal3D = _rlC > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_blr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
  Bal3D = _rrC > 0 ? vcat(Bal3D, mprism(_brr, _bz0, _bz1)) : Bal3D
end
balusterCount = balusterCount + _nC * _bpt * (_rlC + _rrC)
# handrail: a sloped bar from above the first nosing to above the last, on each railed side
_h0zC = _z0C + _R + _RH
_h1zC = _z0C + _nC * _R + _RH
loop s in 2:
  _wside = s == 0 ? _ri : (_W - _ri)
  _on = _nC > 0 ? (s == 0 ? _rlC : _rrC) : 0
  _c0 = hcat(_oxC + _axC * _wside, _oyC + _ayC * _wside)
  _c1 = hcat(_oxC + _dxC * _nC * _T + _axC * _wside, _oyC + _dyC * _nC * _T + _ayC * _wside)
  _cw = hcat(_axC * _rs, _ayC * _rs)
  _r8 = vcat(vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)), vcat(vcat(_c0 - _cw, _c0 + _cw), vcat(_c1 + _cw, _c1 - _cw)))
  _r8z = vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zC - _rs), hcat(_h0zC - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h1zC - _rs), hcat(_h1zC - _rs)), vcat(vcat(hcat(_h0zC + _rs), hcat(_h0zC + _rs)), vcat(hcat(_h1zC + _rs), hcat(_h1zC + _rs)))))
  _r8w = hcat(_cx + col(_r8, 0) * _ca - col(_r8, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_r8, 0) * _sa + col(_r8, 1) * _ca, _r8z)
  _fb = 2000 + 500 + s * 6
  _F0 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3))), fill(4, 1, _fb))
  _F1 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 5)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 1))
  _F2 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 0), row(_r8w, 1)), vcat(row(_r8w, 5), row(_r8w, 4))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 2))
  _F3 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 1), row(_r8w, 2)), vcat(row(_r8w, 6), row(_r8w, 5))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 3))
  _F4 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 2), row(_r8w, 3)), vcat(row(_r8w, 7), row(_r8w, 6))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 4))
  _F5 = hcat(vcat(vcat(row(_r8w, 3), row(_r8w, 0)), vcat(row(_r8w, 4), row(_r8w, 7))), fill(4, 1, _fb + 5))
  Rail3D = _on > 0 ? vcat(Rail3D, vcat(vcat(vcat(_F0, _F1), vcat(_F2, _F3)), vcat(_F4, _F5))) : Rail3D
  RailPlan = _on > 0 ? vcat(RailPlan, hcat(_cx + col(_c0, 0) * _ca - col(_c0, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c0, 0) * _sa + col(_c0, 1) * _ca, _cx + col(_c1, 0) * _ca - col(_c1, 1) * _sa, _cy + col(_c1, 0) * _sa + col(_c1, 1) * _ca)) : RailPlan
  handrailLength = handrailLength + _on * _nC * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T))
end
_faC = _nC > 0 ? (_nC * _T * _R / 2 + _nC * _T * _wv - _wv * _wv * _T / (2 * _R)) : 0
flightConcrete = flightConcrete + (_open > 0 ? 0 : _faC * _W)
formworkArea = formworkArea + (_open > 0 ? 0 : (2 * _faC + _W * _nC * _T * sqrt(1 + (_R / _T) * (_R / _T)) + _W * _nC * _R))

# ── landings: SLABS of _LT, with a beam under the outer edge when asked ──────────────────────────
_nl = _isUM ? 2 : (_isU ? 1 : (_L > 0 ? 1 : 0))
Beams3D = zeros(0, 4)
landingConcrete = 0
beamConcrete = 0
_bw = max(0.05, beamWidth)
_bd = max(0.05, beamDepth)
loop m in _nl:
  _lx0 = _isUM ? _xt : (_isU ? _xt : _dir * _N * _T)
  _lx1 = _isUM ? _xr : (_isU ? _xl : _dir * (_N * _T + _L))
  _ly0 = _isUM ? (m > 0 ? _y2 : 0) : 0
  _ly1 = _isUM ? (m > 0 ? _y3 : _W) : (_isU ? (2 * _W + _G) : _W)
  _lh1 = _isUM ? (m > 0 ? (_pa + _mid) * _R : _pa * _R) : (_isU ? _n1 * _R : _N * _R)
  _lh0 = _open > 0 ? max(0, _lh1 - _TT) : max(0, _lh1 - _LT)
  _px = _lx0 + _ux * (_lx1 - _lx0)
  _py = _ly0 + _uy * (_ly1 - _ly0)
  _ring = hcat(_cx + _px * _ca - _py * _sa, _cy + _px * _sa + _py * _ca)
  Landings = vcat(Landings, hcat(_ring, fill(4, 1, m)))
  LandMesh = vcat(LandMesh, mprism(_ring, _lh0, _lh1))
  landingConcrete = landingConcrete + abs(_lx1 - _lx0) * abs(_ly1 - _ly0) * (_lh1 - _lh0)
  _bx1 = _lx1
  _bx0 = _lx1 - _dir * (_lx1 > _lx0 ? 1 : -1) * _dir * _bw
  _bxa = min(_bx0, _bx1)
  _bxb = max(_bx0, _bx1)
  _bpx = _bxa + _ux * (_bxb - _bxa)
  _bpy = _ly0 + _uy * (_ly1 - _ly0)
  _bring = hcat(_cx + _bpx * _ca - _bpy * _sa, _cy + _bpx * _sa + _bpy * _ca)
  Beams3D = (showBeams > 0 && _open == 0) ? vcat(Beams3D, mprism(_bring, _lh0 - _bd, _lh0)) : Beams3D
  beamConcrete = beamConcrete + ((showBeams > 0 && _open == 0) ? _bw * _bd * abs(_ly1 - _ly0) : 0)
end
_gx0 = _dir * 0.5 * _T
_gy0 = _W / 2
_gx1 = _isUM ? _xr : (_isU ? _xt : _dir * (_N + 0.5) * _T)
_gy1 = _isUM ? _W / 2 : (_isU ? _W / 2 : _W / 2)
ArrowPlan = hcat(_cx + _gx0 * _ca - _gy0 * _sa, _cy + _gx0 * _sa + _gy0 * _ca, _cx + _gx1 * _ca - _gy1 * _sa, _cy + _gx1 * _sa + _gy1 * _ca)
stepCount = _N
riserHeight = _R
treadDepth = _T
totalRise = _N * _R
goingLength = _N * _T
flightWidth = _W
pitchDeg = atan2(_R, _T) * 180 / PI
rule2RT = 2 * _R + _T
headroomOk = _R <= 0.19 && _T >= 0.25 ? 1 : 0
stairArea = _isUM ? (_pa * _T + _W) * (_W + _mid * _T + _W) : (_isU ? (_n1 * _T + _L) * (2 * _W + _G) : (_N * _T + _L) * _W)
StepMesh = _open > 0 ? StepMesh : zeros(0, 4)
concreteVolume = flightConcrete + landingConcrete + beamConcrete + (_open > 0 ? _N * _T * _W * _TT : 0)
concreteWeight = 25 * concreteVolume
flightCount = _isUM ? 3 : (_isU ? 2 : 1)
waistThickness = max(0.05, waist)
